verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a sync/backup server is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows backup and sync only go to vendor clouds: Cloud Backup is stored in a Microsoft personal account, and iOS backup requires iCloud. No self-hostable sync server or on-premises secret storage is documented.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter
